label: Unhandled error capture
description: Reports errors your code does not catch, without any extra calls.

label: Manual error submission
description: Sends an error you caught and handled.

label: Log messages
description: Sends log events with a source and a level.

label: Feature usage
description: Sends an event each time a feature is used.

label: 404 tracking
description: Reports requests for resources that do not exist.

label: User identity
description: Attaches a user ID and name to events.

label: Sessions and heartbeats
description: Sends session start, heartbeat, and end events.

label: Reference IDs
description: Gives each error a short ID that a user can quote to support.

label: Server-synced configuration values
description: Reads project settings from the server and reacts when they change.

label: Plugins
description: Adds data to events or cancels them before they are sent.

label: Data exclusions
description: Removes sensitive fields from events on the client.

label: Offline queue persistence
description: Keeps queued events across restarts and sends them when the network returns.

label: Deduplication
description: Merges identical errors that occur in a short window into one event with a count.

label: Source maps
description: Readable stack traces for minified JavaScript.
